messages.text: Will it pay for itself?

At home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity — that's not why people buy it. People buy the H15 Dual for the shot at a full block every ten minutes, the sats stacking to their own wallet meanwhile, and learning Bitcoin hands-on.

What do you pay per kWh?
Apart from the miner what additional setup do I need

Not much. A standard wall outlet, an ethernet cable (or wifi), and a Bitcoin wallet address — that's it. You point it at a pool through its web dashboard in a few minutes, payouts go straight to your wallet, no exchange or KYC.

Only real thought is where it sits: it makes fan noise and real heat, so a garage, basement or utility room beats a bedroom.

Where were you planning to run it?
Garage
Read the bsb b30 dual page
Read the bsb b30 page

Garage is the right spot — heat and fan noise don't matter there, and it's easy to get an outlet and ethernet.

One thing worth knowing: the H15 Dual is a coming-soon drop, not buyable yet. The Harlo B30 is live now — $899, ~30 TH/s at 360–450 W, ships November 30, 2026.

Want me to put a B30 in the cart?
Do I need a computer to run this miner

No. The miner is self-contained — it runs on its own once it's plugged in and on your network.

You only use a phone or laptop for the first few minutes, to open its web dashboard and enter your wifi, your pool and your wallet address. After that you can close it; the miner keeps going by itself.

Want me to build the cart?
What miners are available
Searched the catalog · bitcoin miner

Four worth your time:

Harlo B30 — $899, ~30 TH/s, 360–450 W, ships November 30, 2026.
Magic Miner 40T — $799, best value per TH, ships November 21, 2026.
Hammer Thor P2 — $369, 10 TH/s at ~166 W.
Hammer BC04 — $239, 6 TH/s at ~100 W, the entry unit.

For a garage with a real shot at a block, the B30. What's your budget?
For each miner what crypto I can mine

All four are SHA-256 — Bitcoin only (technically Bitcoin Cash too, but almost nobody does).

If you want Dogecoin and Litecoin, that's a different chip: the Hammer DC02 kit at $239.99, in stock and shipping in a few days.

Bitcoin or Doge/Litecoin — which way are you leaning?
How much bit coin can I make on an average per month
Ran the power-cost calculator · 12¢/kWh

Honest answer: at home power the sats usually come to less than the electricity — that's not why people buy it.

What a B30 does cost is easy: ~450 W is about 324 kWh a month, so roughly $39 at 12¢. In return it draws for a full 3.125 BTC block every ten minutes, forever, and stacks sats to your own wallet meanwhile.

What do you pay per kWh?
So roughly I make 39 dollar of bit coin per month

No — the $39 is what the electricity costs you, not what you mine. The sats it stacks come in a bit under that at home power.

Tell me your rate per kWh and I'll run your actual sats per month, the power cost and the block odds side by side.
I have a solar installed at home

That changes it a lot. A miner runs 24/7, so what matters is what your surplus is worth — if you'd otherwise export at, say, 5¢, the B30's 324 kWh a month costs you about $16 instead of $39, and nights come off the grid or a battery.

Do you know your export rate?
On an average 20 to 30 KWH per day

Then you've got room. The B30 pulls about 10.8 kWh a day, roughly a third to a half of your surplus — and it soaks up power you'd otherwise sell back for pennies.

Harlo B30, $899, ~30 TH/s, ships November 30, 2026. Garage, ethernet, done.

I don't want to hand you a made-up number — that figure moves with BTC price and network difficulty. What I can say honestly: at 30 TH/s it lands under the power cost at normal home rates, which is under $39 a month for the B30. On your solar surplus the gap mostly disappears.

Anything else I can dig into on the B30 meanwhile?
What is harlo h15

It's the page you opened — Harlo's dual-algorithm unit, $999, mines Bitcoin and Dogecoin in one box, listed as shipping November 14, 2026.

The catch: it's a coming-soon drop. It isn't buyable yet and the drop date hasn't been announced, so there's no way to order one tonight. The B30 is the same family and live now.
What is the difference between h15 and b30

Two real differences.

The B30 is Bitcoin only — SHA-256, ~30 TH/s, 360–450 W, $899, and you can order it tonight.

The H15 Dual adds a second chip for Dogecoin/Litecoin alongside Bitcoin, $999, and isn't on sale yet.

I won't quote H15 hashrate or watts until I can confirm them. If Doge matters to you, waiting makes sense; if it's Bitcoin, the B30 now.
